notes.note: Reviewed the follow-up lib.rs/cache-test delta: cache.read now receives one explicit observation time, supplied by SystemTime::now() at the production caller, and uses it consistently for metadata trust. The restored-mtime regression freezes an ambiguous time; the collision regression forces matching cached file versions over 64 same-size edits and checks both ambiguous and settled observations without a clock-tick sleep. Existing custody, revisions, per-read file validation, Windows reads and native/runtime qualification limits are unchanged. Hosted Rust confirmation is pending; this note is a bounded source-delta review.
